name: @cosmosledgerlabs/solana-saga
description: Run a sequence of Solana transactions as a saga: when any step fails, the completed steps are compensated in reverse order (a confirmed transaction is offset by a new one, never 'rolled back'). Ships a hardened send/confirm engine: poll-based confirmation, rebroadcast under load, fresh-blockhash expiry retries, and a duplicate-send guard.
author: COSMOS Ledger Labs Inc.
